title: Santa Rally vs. The January Bill
headline: Can Christmas come early?
subtitle: Goldman, Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan flag a year-end squeeze setup.
Upstream inflation says the bill lands in Q1 2027.

rows.label: Positions cleared
lines: Goldman: one of the sharpest de-grossings in a decade.
MS: AI net exposure underweight for the first time since 2023.
Hedge fund de-grossing has run longest in 15+ years.

rows.label: Valuation back, earnings up
lines: MSCI World fwd P/E 15.6x, PEG 1.1x - near post-1997 means.
S&P 500 17.9x vs 18.9x implied by 2.25% real yields.
2026-28 EPS upgrades; bad news left prices steady.

rows.label: The pipeline is running hot
lines: Global mfg import prices ~24% annualized, above 2021-22 peak.
Global PPI ~11%; pressure spreading beyond energy, AI hardware.
25-40% of import baskets >5%; US PPI categories >40%.

rows.label: January does the resetting
lines: ~16 CPI components jump >2 SD in January; others <=2.5.
6-12 month pass-through; Oct PPI +6.5% y/y; CPI beat 69/70.
GS added a third Fed rate hike to its forecast.

takeaway: "Short every consensus trade" - Goldman's 2026 rule. "Good luck."
GS macro note (Nov 13, 2026) via Futu News (Nov 14, 2026). A rally loosens financial conditions.
